title: Simulation Suite v0
description: Small, reviewable synthetic environments for measuring harness-level improvement before external benchmark adapters.

split_contract.train: Visible to diagnosis and proposal generation.
split_contract.heldout: Never used by proposal generation; validates Hn+1.
split_contract.regression: Protected behaviors that must not degrade.

required.reason: Harnesses must learn to extract the user's true objective from proposal evidence.
Prior learnings need protected regression checks.
Coding harness proposals need failure-signal evidence.
Coding improvements must show they recognize regression risk.
Data-oriented harness changes need schema mismatch validation.
Support-style harnesses must preserve policy compliance.
World-model harness changes need state consistency as proposal evidence.
World-model validation must detect impossible transitions.
World-model state consistency needs one protected regression hook.

waivers.reason: Mechanics probes are regression-only until train pressure needs deterministic evaluator debugging.
waivers.expires_when: Train split starts using mechanics probes for evaluator debugging.

waivers.reason: Mechanics probes are regression-only in sim-v0.1.
waivers.expires_when: Heldout mechanics probes become part of promotion validation.

waivers.reason: Patch-targeting regressions are deferred until repo-backed fixtures exist.
waivers.expires_when: Repo-backed coding fixtures land in sim-v0.

waivers.reason: Data-ops regression fixtures are deferred until asset-backed schemas are added.
waivers.expires_when: Asset-backed schema fixtures land in sim-v0.
